from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

# Prepare the data for regression across multiple years
years = [col for col in education_expenditure.columns if 'YR' in col]

# Initialize lists to store the coefficients and R-squared values
coefficients_education_gdp = []
r_squared_education_gdp = []
coefficients_gdp_output = []
r_squared_gdp_output = []

# Perform regression for each year
for year in years:
    # Extract the data for the selected year
    education_expenditure_year = education_expenditure[year].values.reshape(-1, 1)
    per_capita_gdp_year = per_capita_gdp[year].values
    economic_output_year = economic_output[year].values

    # Perform linear regression to analyze the relationship between education expenditure and per capita GDP
    regression_model_1 = LinearRegression()
    regression_model_1.fit(education_expenditure_year, per_capita_gdp_year)
    coefficient_1 = regression_model_1.coef_[0]
    intercept_1 = regression_model_1.intercept_
    r_squared_1 = r2_score(per_capita_gdp_year, regression_model_1.predict(education_expenditure_year))

    # Perform linear regression to analyze the relationship between per capita GDP and economic output
    regression_model_2 = LinearRegression()
    regression_model_2.fit(per_capita_gdp_year.reshape(-1, 1), economic_output_year)
    coefficient_2 = regression_model_2.coef_[0]
    intercept_2 = regression_model_2.intercept_
    r_squared_2 = r2_score(economic_output_year, regression_model_2.predict(per_capita_gdp_year.reshape(-1, 1)))

    coefficients_education_gdp.append(coefficient_1)
    r_squared_education_gdp.append(r_squared_1)
    coefficients_gdp_output.append(coefficient_2)
    r_squared_gdp_output.append(r_squared_2)

# Create a DataFrame to store the results
results_df = pd.DataFrame({
    'Year': years,
    'Coefficient (Education Expenditure - GDP)': coefficients_education_gdp,
    'R-squared (Education Expenditure - GDP)': r_squared_education_gdp,
    'Coefficient (GDP - Economic Output)': coefficients_gdp_output,
    'R-squared (GDP - Economic Output)': r_squared_gdp_output
})
